body_markdown:
SMP’s Engineered Solutions Team will showcase its diverse product portfolio at IAA Transportation 2026, taking place September 15-20 in Hanover, Germany. Visitors can meet the team in Hall 12, Booth A23, and learn about the company’s capabilities across multiple product categories. The exhibit will feature HVAC Components, including Electrical Compressors and related thermal management solutions, as well as Straps and Bands, including fuel tank straps. SMP will also highlight its portfolio of Switches and Sensors, which support a wide range of applications, from speed, fluid level, and pressure sensing to advanced soot monitoring technologies.


IAA Transportation provides a unique opportunity for customers and industry peers to meet experts from across the SMP Engineered Solutions Team to gain a comprehensive overview of the Company’s capabilities. “IAA Transportation is one of the industry’s most important global events and provides an ideal platform to demonstrate the breadth of our Engineered Solutions portfolio. Bringing our HVAC Components, Straps and Bands, and Switches and Sensors product experts together in one location allows customers to gain a comprehensive understanding of how our products can support their evolving needs” said Piotr Sosnowski, Senior Vice President, Engineered Solutions and Managing Director, SMP Europe. The SMP Engineered Solutions team looks forward to learning about customer challenges, showcasing innovative solutions, and strengthening relationships with partners from around the world.
